title: A Veil for the Oath
author: Beatrix Sterling
blurb: Theo Winterbourne, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
